page_title: WHU 0-0 BHA | West Ham v Brighton 02/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Pascal Gross (Brighton) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+2' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

89' Adam Lallana (Brighton) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Alphonse Areola has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
88' Jakub Moder (Brighton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
86' Jakub Moder (Brighton) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
83' Jakub Moder (Brighton) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
81' Adam Lallana (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
80' Joao Pedro (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' Total attempts – 6:14.
79' Adam Lallana (Brighton) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Alphonse Areola easily makes the save.
78' Pascal Gross (Brighton) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jakub Moder (Brighton) replaces Adam Webster.
74' It is time for a substitution. Adam Lallana (Brighton) is on for Facundo Buonanotte.
73' Here is a change. Said Benrahma is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Divin Mubama (West Ham).
69' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
68' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Billy Gilmour (Brighton) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
67' That will be all from Danny Welbeck who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Evan Ferguson (Brighton).
66' Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
64' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' Jason Steele leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).

63' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

61' What a huge chance for Tomas Soucek (West Ham). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
61' Said Benrahma (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
59' Joao Pedro (Brighton) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Alphonse Areola.
59' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
58' Said Benrahma (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

55' This was a piece of cake for Alphonse Areola. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
53' A pass into the penalty area from Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is intercepted by the defence.
52' A pass from James Milner (Brighton) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
49' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
46' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Emerson (West Ham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
44' Said Benrahma (West Ham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

42' Pascal Gross (Brighton) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alphonse Areola shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
42' Brighton are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
40' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.

37' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

35' Said Benrahma (West Ham) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

33' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.

33' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the top right corner, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a decent save to deny him.
32' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
31' What was Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
29' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
29' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is intercepted by the defence.
28' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
26' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Tomas Soucek (West Ham) offside.

23' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alphonse Areola pulls off an easy save.
22' James Milner (Brighton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
20' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
19' Joao Pedro (Brighton) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' An attempted cross from Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) is cleared.
15' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Samuel Barrott stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but Jason Steele punches the ball away.
12' Said Benrahma (West Ham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' The ratio of the ball possession is 26:74.
8' James Milner (Brighton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
4' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is introduced as the referee for today's match.
